verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm docs list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) by name on both the PyTorch and JAX install pages. The Radeon support table covers PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX and ONNX on Linux and PyTorch on Windows, and a ROCm compatibility-matrix selector is published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ML frameworks running on this card, and Windows support documented only for PyTorch (TensorFlow, JAX and ONNX are Linux-only).

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices
